name: Empresas CMPC S.A.
summary: Empresas CMPC S.A. engages in the production and sale of pulp and wood products in Chile and internationally. It operates through Pulp, Biopackaging, and Softys segments. The Pulp segment produces and markets pulp, forestry, and lumber products to the industrial pulp mills, remanufactured products, and plywood plants. This segment also offers sawn lumber, remanufactured products, and plywood sheets, as well as owns forest plantations, primarily pine and eucalyptus. The Biopackaging segment provides elaborated paper products, such as bags or industrial sacks, as well as molded pulp trays, and corrugation and corrugated cardboard boxes; manufactures and retails bags; and distributes papers.
